[SWS_DM_01446] SOVD method Retrieve Groups Supported by a Data Resource Collection
⌈
If a SOVD entity support SOVD data and if the
SOVD has at least one SOVD data-group configured, the SOVD method Retrieve
Groups Supported by a Data Resource Collection shall be supported ac-
cording to ASAM SOVD[2].
⌋

[SWS_DM_01446] Support of SOVD method Retrieve Groups Supported by a Data Resource Collection
⌈
The DM shall support the SOVD method Retrieve Groups Supported by a
Data Resource Collection according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
